# PEAD_POWER_PRELIMINARY.md — post-earnings drift, dispersion only

**PRELIMINARY. NOT REGISTERED. NOT FROZEN. NOTHING IS CHARGED TO A FAMILY.** The top and bottom fifths are drawn AT RANDOM within each monthly cohort: no surprise was set against any return. Generated by `python -m src.research.pead_power`.

- company-quarters with a filing date: **61,594** (2007-03-31 .. 2026-09-30); 1,582 without one are left out (no safe entry day)
- with an NSE symbol matched to an ISIN on the filing date: **61,350**

## How to read it

The MDE is the smallest true spread this sample could detect at 5% two-sided with 80% power, after the serial correction for overlapping horizons (0033). Below 1.00x the design is powered at the bound; a registration would still freeze the SUE definition, the fifths, the horizon and the benchmark before any spread is read. Events end at the reproducibility horizon (2026-08-31).
